privacyPolicy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: CineClub is a scheduling and social platform for members of a local independent-cinema club. This page explains what personal data we collect, why, and what control members have over it.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Account data (email, display name, avatar, bio), activity data (RSVPs, friend connections, chat messages), and — if used — your 42 Intra login or two-factor authentication secret.

purpose.title: Why we collect it
purpose.body: To operate the club's shared screening schedule, let members recognise and message each other, generate your personal calendar export, and secure your account.

thirdParties.title: Third parties
thirdParties.body: Screening times come from the public datacinesindes.fr feed. Movie information and translations are provided via The Movie Database (TMDB). This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB. We do not sell or share your data with advertisers.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can export a copy of everything we hold about your account, or request permanent deletion, at any time from your profile settings.

termsOfService.heading: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: These terms govern your use of CineClub, a scheduling and social platform for the members of a local independent-cinema club. By creating an account, you agree to them.

membership.title: Membership
membership.body: Accounts are for individual club members. You're responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential and for activity under your account.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable use
acceptableUse.body: Be respectful in chat, RSVP honestly, and don't attempt to access another member's account or misuse the schedule.

screeningData.title: Screening data
screeningData.body: Screening times are pulled from the public datacinesindes.fr feed and may occasionally be inaccurate or change without notice on the cinema's side — always double-check before travelling.

termination.title: Termination
termination.body: You may delete your account at any time. We may suspend accounts that violate these terms.
